comparison.objective: Ratchet a top-over cargo strap taut, latch its handle, and prove restraint during a deck jolt; candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop and proves retained opening through cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1285 tests repeated lever strokes through a pawl, handle detent latching, and cargo restraint; candidate tests coaxial driver and wrench control, reaction counterholding, precise locknut tightening, tool withdrawal, and articulated cycling.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1285 requires at least 50 N strap tension, a shut latched handle, clearance, and crate motion within 2.5 mm/2° during the jolt; candidate requires a 90° stop within 3°, no more than 2° drift over three cycles, retained nuts, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Although both lock an adjusted mechanism and verify it under later motion, repeated ratchet take-up and cargo-load survival test a different ability from preserving a screw setting during jam-nut countertorque; the record provides complete tension, latch, motion, failure, and dwell thresholds.
